name: JustWatch – Partner Integrations
author: justwatchplugin

sections.description:
The JustWatch Partner Integrations WordPress plugin connects your site to the JustWatch Partner API, making it easy to display legal streaming options for movies and TV shows. Designed for bloggers, content creators, and movie enthusiasts, this plugin delivers real-time, region-specific streaming information directly to your audience.

Key Features

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Access the latest updates for up to 250,000 movies, 60,000 TV shows, and over 500 providers in more than 100 countries.
  • Editor Support: Embed streaming widgets effortlessly using the Block Editor or Classic Editor.
  • Customization: Tailor the widget’s appearance with color theme options.
  • Locale-Based Offers: Automatically display offers based on the visitor’s region.
  • Optional Geo-IP Integration: Integrate with a third-party Geo-IP detection plugin for enhanced detection capabilities.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JustWatch API to search for movies and shows and to display related streaming offers. The integration is necessary for the plugin’s core functionality.

What is sent: When a user performs a search or views a title, the plugin sends the search query or title metadata (e.g., title name, internal ID) to the JustWatch API.

When data is sent: Data is sent in real time during plugin usage (e.g., when rendering a title’s availability or initiating a search). No personal or user-identifiable data is transmitted.

Service provider: JustWatch GmbH, Saarbrücker Straße 38, DE – 10405 Berlin

Terms of Service: https://partners.justwatch.com/legal/termsofuse

Privacy Policy: https://partners.justwatch.com/legal/privacypolicy

Additionally, the plugin can optionally embed the JustWatch Widget, which also connects to JustWatch servers to load streaming offer content. No user data is transmitted unless the widget is explicitly used.

Widget documentation: https://apis.justwatch.com/docs/widget

For questions or partnership inquiries, contact us at data-partner@justwatch.com or learn more at https://partners.justwatch.com.
sections.installation:
1. Automatic Installation

    • In your WordPress Dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New.
    • Search for JustWatch Partner Integrations and click Install Now.
    • Activate the plugin.

  2. Manual Installation

    • Download the plugin ZIP file from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
    • Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin in your WordPress Dashboard.
    • Upload the ZIP file, click Install Now, and activate the plugin.

  3. Optional Geo-IP Integration

    • To enhance region detection, install the Geolocation IP Detection Plugin.
    • Configure it to use MaxMind GeoIP Lite City (free license key available here).

  4. Obtain Your JustWatch API Key

    • To access the JustWatch plugin, please request your unique token by completing this form or email us at data-partner@justwatch.com.

  5. Set Up API Key

    • Navigate to Settings > JustWatch in your WordPress Dashboard.
    • Insert your JustWatch API key and adjust optional settings like branded links or error messages.

  6. Embed Streaming Options

    • Open a post or page in the editor.
    • Add the JustWatch Block from the block library or select the JustWatch Toolbutton in the classic editor.
    • Search for a movie or TV show, select it, and update the post.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require Geo-IP integration?

No, the plugin detects the visitor’s region using browser locale, headers, and WordPress settings by default. Geo-IP integration is optional and provides additional accuracy.

How often is the streaming data updated?

Streaming data is updated daily to ensure the latest availability information for your audience.

Can I customize the widget’s appearance?

Yes, you can adjust the widget’s color theme to match your site design.
